Search is noticed that it is the common thread that binds most of the problem-solving strategies in AI together.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.32628/ijsrset22962\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2022, 11, 1]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.7610838\", \"title\": [\"Autonomous Thermal Engineering: Integration of Digital Twins, Artificial Intelligence, and Advanced Heat Transfer Mechanisms for Sustainable Energy Systems\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>Thermal engineering systems are increasingly facing challenges associated with dynamic operating conditions, energy efficiency demands, and the transition toward sustainable energy infrastructures. This study presents an autonomous thermal engineering framework that integrates digital twins, artificial intelligence (AI), and advanced heat transfer mechanisms to enhance the performance, reliability, and adaptability of next-generation energy systems. The proposed framework combines real-time sensing, physics-based thermal modelling, machine learning algorithms, and intelligent optimization strategies to continuously monitor, predict, and regulate thermal behaviour. The digital twin establishes a virtual representation of physical thermal systems, enabling accurate simulation, fault prediction, and autonomous decision-making under varying environmental and operational conditions. AI-driven models improve thermal management by learning complex nonlinear relationships between operating parameters, heat transfer characteristics, and system performance indicators. Advanced heat transfer technologies, including enhanced convection, phase-change materials, nanofluids, and adaptive thermal control mechanisms, support improved heat dissipation and energy utilization. The integrated approach provides a self-optimizing thermal architecture that reduces energy losses, increases system efficiency, and promotes sustainable operation. The framework demonstrates significant potential for applications in renewable energy systems, industrial thermal processes, electric mobility, and smart energy networks.
